description: An item in the .csproj that declares a NuGet dependency, where Version="3.6.0" means 3.6.0 or higher with the lowest available version preferred.
A short .csproj whose Sdk attribute brings in the build logic and which compiles every .cs file under its folder without listing them.
A package your project receives because one of its direct packages depends on it, recorded with the rest of the graph in obj/project.assets.json.
Keeping every package version of a repository in one Directory.Packages.props file, with version-less PackageReference items in the projects.
An opt-in packages.lock.json that records the full resolved graph, so restore with --locked-mode fails instead of silently changing versions.
A vulnerability check that runs on every restore and reports NU1901 to NU1904 warnings, covering transitive packages by default for net10.0 projects.
The standard identifier, such as MIT or Apache-2.0, that a package declares as its licence and that nuget.org shows on the package page.
